evidence_policy: Status records require exact-head executed proof; pending verification is NOT_RUN. Desktop unavailable is LOCAL_REQUIRED.

requirements.implementation: Studio starts at exact repaired 2c5b4e2; separate private Cloud baseline ec487c4 retains later audited lifecycle/security fixes. Frozen PR heads are unchanged.
Cloud-feasible protocol, adapters and Studio integration are implemented. Actual Tutor Desktop discovery/runtime remains LOCAL_REQUIRED.
Product implementations communicate through serialized versioned protocol. No cross-product internal imports, writes or executable capabilities.
29 strict JSON Schemas, Python DTOs/validators, strict-TypeScript DTOs and Rust interface draft; shared parity and both wheel manifests verified. Rust compilation NOT_RUN.
Every wire message requires explicit protocol name/version; missing or incompatible identity fails closed. Product versions remain independent.
Stable product IDs, product role, instance, separate software versions, capabilities and supported protocol versions are validated.

Real loopback HELLO, capability negotiation and nonce-bound session, including negative order/version/session cases. Protocol and local host-user/session binding are verified, but development HTTP ProductDescriptor is self-declared, not authenticated installed-product/OS-user identity; actual mutual desktop peer attestation remains LOCAL_REQUIRED.
The 16 stable allowed capabilities are explicit; no execution, credential or project-write grant exists.
Live authorized Studio context produces immutable metadata-only capsules by default; source/hash/time/IDs/evidence are validated.
Explicit preview and confirmation for metadata, saved selection, current chapter or a bounded specifically chosen chapter set. Whole-project fallback is absent.
Host provenance validates authority; LLM ADVISORY cannot override AUTHORITATIVE FAILED state.
Evidence source/version/hash/time/authority/privacy validated; opaque locators are never dereferenced.
Windows current-user SID ACL, remote-denial, framing/cancel reference is authored; real Tutor Desktop transport integration unavailable. Native reference execution is a separate hosted CI check.
Actual separate-process 127.0.0.1 transport; proxies, redirects, URL tokens, DNS/LAN hosts and credentials are rejected.
Bounded read-only discovery of explicitly configured local peer is implemented. Native installed-app/pipe discovery awaits Desktop integration; nothing is launched or scanned.

All event types have strict contracts; live publisher emits project/task/chapter/model/runtime changes with bounded coalescing. Remaining product-specific emitters are not fabricated. Current automatic publication uses timer-polled authorized snapshots, not direct hooks for every application event source.
Host rechecks authority at event delivery and response send; membership/session/project/scope/disable revocation terminates affected subscriptions while independent authorized readers continue.
Unified Ask Tutor entry uses existing Studio shell and Settings entry, preserving NOVEL/IMAGE/VIDEO layout.
Metadata preview defaults on; selection/chapter/specific context defaults off. Confirmation, cancellation, interrupted flows and source versions are exercised by UI/Host tests.
Advisory guidance, steps, warnings, references and structured verification render without executing operations or changing prose/settings.
Versioned action semantics and authorized local route handling are independent of UI URI registration. Real OS scheme registration is not added.
Only explicit local click requests navigate after product/target/scope/version checks; advice itself does not navigate.
Credential-free allowlist projection of captured local model/runtime metadata; no probing, model install or provider execution.
Unknown secret-bearing fields and credential-shaped content rejected; model projection never serializes a credential store or transport token.

requirements.requirement: 第一阶段 Model Registry 权限
requirements.implementation: Only model registry/status reads exist; model.execute is explicitly disabled.
TaskRequirement and advisory ModelRecommendation strict DTOs are available. Automatic routing/execution and richer recommendation UI are not implemented.
Diagnostic allowlist excludes raw manuscript, prompts, screenshots, paths, DSN, credentials and arbitrary log dumps.
Exact diagnostic/envelope preview supports removing fields before confirmation; snapshot is sanitized, versioned, bounded and LOCAL_ONLY.
Verifier evaluates structured conditions against fresh independently trusted host state/evidence. Both independent adapters have deterministic verification paths.

requirements.requirement: Verifier 不能相信 LLM 自报成功
requirements.implementation: Guidance never changes the FAILED task. Negative tests reject LLM success; VERIFIED follows only an explicit new trusted source state satisfying the condition.
Local CaseCandidate DTO and mapping include problem/environment/guidance/result/verification/evidence; no automatic persistence/upload.

requirements.requirement: Case 写入必须用户确认
requirements.implementation: Studio supports preview/explicit approval; independent reference adapter enforces fresh permission/source at Memory Gate. Actual cross-product Desktop Memory Gate wiring remains LOCAL_REQUIRED.
Derived privacy preserves the strictest source, including capsule privacy; summaries cannot implicitly gain cloud consent.
Read-only Studio provider reuses current real authorization, project/chapter/task/error/model/runtime/feature sources and saved selection metadata.
Independent Tutor adapter validates existing Context V2/Tutor/Verifier/Case contracts. Real Desktop composition remains LOCAL_REQUIRED.
Settings integration displays detected peer, protocol/capabilities and forbidden execution/write capabilities.
Independent server feature flag plus user opt-in default OFF. Disable clears bridge sessions/subscriptions without deleting projects or history.
Permission/capability UI describes status/model reads and per-request content/handoff consent.
No interop log stores prose, prompts, selection, credentials or personal paths. Reference adapter audit records only bounded opaque operation metadata.
Canonical typed error codes survive transport and frontend handling; arbitrary upstream strings are not used as authority.
Bounded deadlines and cancellation cover waiting calls; old request/session responses are rejected and cannot populate new UI state.

Product/instance/user/protocol/capability/nonce/time bindings are enforced; fresh host instance invalidates prior sessions. Protocol and local host-user/session binding are verified, but development HTTP ProductDescriptor is self-declared, not authenticated installed-product/OS-user identity; actual mutual desktop peer attestation remains LOCAL_REQUIRED.
Immutable ID/hash/version/time plus live source recheck prevents replayed/changed chapter and same-version tamper from passing.
Bridge is inert on startup, peer absence is contained, waits and queues are bounded, events coalesce, and independent application use remains available.
Development reference transport and protocol work offline without Cloud. Real Tutor local model mode and desktop transport require actual Desktop source/runtime.
Compatibility document records protocol/software versions, optional capabilities, transport boundaries and absence of deprecated fields.
Both products default OFF and force OFF under V1_ACCEPTANCE_MODE; existing acceptance boundaries are preserved.
Shared strict-contract regression suite covers unknown/malformed/missing fields, versions, capabilities, IDs, hashes, time, authority, privacy and schema parity.
Security regressions cover credential exclusion, local transport boundaries, current authorization, revoked sessions, stale scope/source, forged authority and handoff validation.
Authoritative FAILED cannot be overwritten by Tutor success; source state is independently bound and fresh.
Independent subscribers/cursors, bounded queue, live revoke and late-response cancellation are exercised; one revocation does not deny another authorized session.
Handoff tests cover invalid product/target, unauthorized scope, missing click, stale source/task and current chapter existence.
Studio default-off and peer-absent behavior remain usable; existing full regression and hosted browser journeys verify the integration boundary.
Reference adapter is optional and inert; existing Cloud application full regression passes without a Studio installation or running process.
Synthetic Tutor, Synthetic Studio and reference HTTP trust fixtures are labelled; no actual Tutor Desktop integration is claimed.
Studio Host/context/events/consent UI/diagnostics/model projection/handoff/flags and independent private reference mappings are implemented in their own repositories.

requirements.requirement: 建议未来抽独立仓库，但本轮不强制
requirements.implementation: Shared versioned protocol is implemented now in both repositories; no dependency on a hypothetical future standalone repository.
All seven required protocol/security/capability/context/tutor/testing/compatibility documents and UI handoff are provided.
This 65-section matrix and PR receipts distinguish DONE/PARTIAL/CONTRACT_VERIFIED/MOCK_ONLY/LOCAL_REQUIRED/NOT_RUN/BLOCKED.
Separate work/local-interop-v1 branches and new Draft PRs: Studio #41 and private reference #4; older PR heads remain unchanged.
No merge/release/deploy/backport/paid API/real manuscript/private credential/model installation/user app autostart/public listener/executable plugin.
Branches and start SHAs are recorded. Final exact-head commit/test receipts and remaining gates are attached to the Draft PR delivery after CI.
Cloud-feasible Studio/synthetic/reference acceptance is implemented. Real Tutor Desktop remains LOCAL_REQUIRED and cannot be certified by mock results.
Versioned case/model metadata/diagnostic/verifier/recommendation interfaces exist; no requirement to implement V1.5 autonomous behavior.

requirements.implementation: No common broker, shared runtime scheduler or cross-product model execution was introduced.
